Spurs wallet money is ONE wallet and the ticket shows no line. Lean prices are first-seen: Pinnacle now has Texas -10.5 at -108 and Minnesota ML about +285; each lean is ONE wallet. 76ers pass: $13.6K of the $17K on the Pacers has a 2-1 record (thin), and $8.5K of counted money is on the 76ers. Cold wallets not counted include $67.7K Minnesota spread, $41.6K Nuggets ML and $11.7K Texas ML. 15 other steady Pinnacle Strong sides are logged, not shown (5-play cap). Star is a rule-based screen, not a prediction.
